stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The story inside had not changed, but people needed help noticing it.”?
options: Good technology should lead eyes back to the world, not trap them on a screen.
A good cover cannot make a bad book good, but a missing cover can hide a good book from busy eyes.
But it became popular because people learned that a shop does not need many choices to make a good impression.
But it taught students that city planning is often about balancing needs, not choosing between good and bad.
